whole_run_windows.clock_domain: Runner reported duration; startup/active are differences of its own time.monotonic values

whole_run_windows.name: cleanup_seconds
whole_run_windows.definition: Original recorded cleanup measurement; original owned-absence failure remains unchanged
whole_run_windows.clock_domain: Runner reported duration; startup/active are differences of its own time.monotonic values

whole_run_windows.name: CLI_wall_seconds
whole_run_windows.definition: Wrapper interval before launching original CLI child through wait, output flushing and exit-record construction
whole_run_windows.clock_domain: Wrapper time.monotonic, distinct process from runner; do not subtract its endpoints from runner or browser timestamps

denominator_rules: Per-request layers overlap and must not be added together.
Native engine processing is only prompt_ms + predicted_ms, summed over the native calls of that request; it excludes all other work.
Per-request sums are not active_seconds or CLI_wall_seconds and do not account for all workflow overhead.
Startup, active and recorded cleanup are distinct measured windows; their rounded sum need not equal the wrapper CLI duration.
No duration is formed by subtracting timestamps from different clock domains.

unavailable_metrics.operational_p95: unavailable; n4/n6 single-run empirical samples only

API_cost.scope: Observed analysis and answer model calls in this local run; no cloud billing statement audit

limits: Read-only aggregation of existing records; no retry, benchmark or fresh instrumentation.
Browser Date.now duration is observed wall time and is not guaranteed monotonic.
Worker and native transport observations include archive/HTTP overhead; they are not isolated compute benchmarks.
Java elapsed_ms is an internally reported service duration, not a separate measured full HTTP span.
No inference about the cause of the original cleanup/owned-absence failure.

Initial model filename suffix assertion failed before any output: normalized argv intentionally stores <verified-model>. Final local-GGUF basis uses actual native process_started, loopback endpoints and matching worker gguf-sha256 model identities; no model file was opened or rehashed.

measured_answer_native_totals.scope: Six actual answer calls only; predicted tokens are all native generated tokens, not a final-answer-only count. Native reported durations are not a cross-clock causal decomposition of browser latency.
